description: NVDA TabSet lets NVDA users quickly check Thailand Stock Exchange (SET) stock data without leaving the keyboard. Toggle TabSet mode with NVDA+Alt+T, press a configured favorite key to fetch a stock quote, and hear the result through NVDA speech. The add-on can report current price details such as last price, change, prior, open, high, low, and last update time, or factsheet details such as P/E, P/BV, market cap, and dividend yield when available from set.or.th. Favorite stock symbols, result language, display mode, and clipboard copying can be configured from the NVDA Settings dialog.
changelog:
